dog.description_text:
Molly's wishes to find a family and home . Molly warms up quickly, and then becomes a loving, gentle friend to all of her people pals. As Molly is a bit bashful initially, she would be best in a home with older, gentle children over 12. She would also be best in the home where she can be your only four-legged family members If you are interested in adopting or fostering, please contact us for further information on her.
This cutie resides at our Westhampton location. We invite you to visit, no appointment needed!
Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
dog.name: Molly
